title: Don’t keep adding to your monthly bills — get 1TB of cloud storage for life for just $75
excerpt: One payment gets you 1TB of cloud storage with no recurring fees.
content_html:
TL;DR: Own your cloud storage space outright with this 1TB lifetime subscription for Vault Cloud Storage, now for just $74.99 (reg. $799).

Credit: Vault

$74.99
$799 Save $724.01

Your digital life is always growing, not shrinking. From family photos and videos to work documents and important personal files, you add to your collection year after year. If you’re looking for a more affordable way to secure your content, Vault Cloud Storage lets you own your space rather than rent it.

Right now, you can secure a lifetime subscription for 1TB of Vault Cloud Storage for just $74.99 (reg. $799).

Your memories are important — they deserve a permanent storage solution. If you’re fed up with paying monthly fees, Vault Cloud Storage lets you pay once and own 1TB of storage outright. This affordable option not only saves you money over time, but it also helps you get your digital life in order.

Vault Cloud Storage uses AES-GCM-256 to encrypt your files directly in your browser before they’re ever uploaded, so only encrypted data is stored in the cloud. That means no readable document contents are ever stored by Vault, keeping your info as secure as possible.

In addition to encrypting your files, Vault Cloud Storage protects your privacy when you log in. Your account is protected by a unique 12-word recovery phrase that only you know.

Once you’re logged in, you can stay on top of your files by sorting them with tags and notes. You can also easily share files via revocable access keys. Need to export files? That’s simple too — and you can access your Vault Cloud Storage account from all compatible web browsers, like Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge.

With Vault Cloud Storage, the maximum file size you can upload is 200 MiB per file, and there’s no daily upload-volume quota. Your lifetime license gives you access to 1TB of space, and if you choose to park your files there for a while, there’s no inactivity deletion.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Snag this 1TB lifetime subscription for Vault Cloud Storage for only $74.99.
